rebuild-config.description: The infrastructure repository contains a complete Terraform plan and a documented rebuild runbook. No clean-room rebuild has been recorded.

audit-retention.description: Application and identity events are retained for 30 days. The requirement is 90 days; immutable storage is not configured.

recovery-drill.description: A restore and regional recovery exercise completed within both stated objectives.

load-test.description: The measured p95 latency met the target at the specified CPU load.

cost-model.description: A dated model estimates monthly spend below the budget. No provider invoice or real consumption data is available.

sovereignty-review.description: The diagram places data in an EU region, but operator jurisdiction and the cost of exit have not been assessed.

risks.description: The audit trail does not meet the required retention period.
Operator jurisdiction and the exit path remain unassessed.
The documented rebuild has not been tested from a clean environment.
Actual provider spend may differ from the estimate.
